name: PCA
tagline: Linear projection onto the top-2 principal components via sklearn.decomposition.PCA (SVD).
diff_from_baseline: Pearson 1901; Hotelling 1933. Closed-form linear baseline that maximizes preserved variance under orthonormal projection.

name: PaCMAP
tagline: Pairwise Controlled Manifold Approximation: combines near-pair, mid-near-pair and far-pair forces for balanced local/global structure.
pseudocode:
1. Build three pair sets: NN ($k{=}10$), mid-near (MN_ratio $0.5$), far (FP_ratio $2.0$).
2. Initialize embedding (PCA scaled).
3. Optimize loss $L = \sum_\mathrm{NN} \frac{d^2}{10+d^2} + \sum_\mathrm{MN} w_\mathrm{MN}\frac{d^2}{10000+d^2} - \sum_\mathrm{FP} \frac{1}{1+d^2}$ with three-phase weight schedule.
4. Use Adam with the schedule (attractive only → balanced → stable).
5. Return 2-D embedding $Z \in \mathbb{R}^{n\times 2}$.
diff_from_baseline: Wang, Huang & Rudin, JMLR 2021. SOTA neighbor-based reducer with three weighted pair types; widely cited for balanced local + global preservation.

name: TriMap
tagline: Triplet-loss embedding: for each point, sample inlier/outlier/random triplets and minimize a t-distributed triplet objective.
pseudocode:
1. For each point $i$, sample $n_\text{in}{=}10$ inlier neighbors, $n_\text{out}{=}5$ outliers, $n_\text{rand}{=}5$ random.
2. Form triplets $(i, j_\text{near}, k_\text{far})$ with weight $w_{ijk} = \exp(-d_{ij}^2 / \sigma_i^2)$.
3. Initialize embedding (PCA).
4. Optimize $L = \sum w_{ijk}\, s(d^Y_{ik}, d^Y_{ij})$ with $s(a,b)=\frac{a^2/(1+a^2)}{a^2/(1+a^2)+b^2/(1+b^2)}$.
5. Run $400$ Adam iters; return 2-D embedding.
diff_from_baseline: Amid & Warmuth 2019 (arXiv:1910.00204). Triplet-based embedding designed to keep large-scale structure that t-SNE / UMAP often distort.

name: UMAP
tagline: Uniform Manifold Approximation: optimize a low-D fuzzy graph to match the high-D fuzzy k-NN graph (Bernoulli cross-entropy).
pseudocode:
1. Build fuzzy simplicial set from $k{=}15$ nearest neighbors with adaptive ρ (local connectivity = 1).
2. Symmetrize via probabilistic t-conorm: $p_{ij} = p_{i|j}+p_{j|i} - p_{i|j}p_{j|i}$.
3. Initialize $Y$ via spectral embedding of the graph.
4. Optimize cross-entropy with attractive force on edges and negative sampling for repulsion, using $q_{ij}=(1+a\,\|y_i-y_j\|^{2b})^{-1}$ with $a,b$ from min_dist=$0.1$.
5. Run SGD; return 2-D embedding.
diff_from_baseline: McInnes, Healy & Melville 2018 (arXiv:1802.03426). Standard nonlinear reducer; faster than t-SNE and tends to preserve more global structure.

name: t-SNE
tagline: Probabilistic neighbor embedding: minimize KL between Gaussian high-D affinities and Student-t low-D affinities.
pseudocode:
1. Compute conditional Gaussian neighborhood probabilities with perplexity $30$, symmetrize: $p_{ij} = (p_{i|j}+p_{j|i})/2n$.
2. Initialize $Y$ from PCA.
3. Define $q_{ij} = (1+\|y_i-y_j\|^2)^{-1}/Z$ (Student-t, df=1).
4. Optimize $L = \mathrm{KL}(P\,\|\,Q) = \sum_{i\ne j} p_{ij}\log\frac{p_{ij}}{q_{ij}}$ with auto learning rate, $1000$ iters.
5. Return $Y\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times 2}$.
diff_from_baseline: van der Maaten & Hinton, JMLR 2008. Classic probabilistic neighborhood-preserving visualizer (sklearn implementation).
